title: The Harbor of the Lower Danube
author: Ansel Ravensworth
blurb: Ines Amberdale, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
